description: This file defines an interface 'FormRecordable' that declares methods for managing form field metadata (namespace and path) associated with objects in the OpenMRS framework. It specifies getter and setter methods with detailed documentation regarding form field identification and validation constraints.

classes.name: FormRecordable
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for associating a form field's namespace and path with an object in the OpenMRS system, enabling linkage between form data and system objects.

methods.name: getFormFieldNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves the namespace associated with the form field used to capture observation details. Returns null if no namespace is specified.

methods.name: getFormFieldPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path for the form field used to capture observation details. Returns null if no path is specified.

methods.name: setFormField
methods.description: Sets the namespace and path for a form field. Implements validation constraints including separator rejection, length limits, and change tracking via 'dirty' marking.
